function.name: web_extract
function.description: Extract content from web page URLs. Returns page content in markdown format. Also works with PDF URLs (arxiv papers, documents, etc.) — pass the PDF link directly and it converts to markdown text. Pages under 5000 chars return full markdown; larger pages are LLM-summarized and capped at ~5000 chars per page. Pages over 2M chars are refused. If a URL fails or times out, use the browser tool to access it instead.

urls.description: List of URLs to extract content from (max 5 URLs per call)

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for information. Returns up to 5 results by default with titles, URLs, and descriptions. The query is passed through to the configured backend, so operators such as site:domain, filetype:pdf, intitle:word, -term, and "exact phrase" may work when the backend supports them.

query.description: The search query to look up on the web. You may include backend-supported operators such as site:example.com, filetype:pdf, intitle:word, -term, or "exact phrase".

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 5.

messages.name: web_search

messages.content:
**Summary of Work Performed**

I conducted targeted web searches to gather current, authoritative medical sources covering the four requested topics for infant week 12 (days 78‑84). The search strategy focused on guidelines and reviews from major professional organizations (AAP, ACOG, CDC) and reputable health‑information sites (HealthyChildren.org, Motherly, PMC). No full‑text extraction was possible due to backend limitations, but I collected URLs, titles, and brief descriptions that point directly to the relevant content.

**Sources Collected**

*Infant Personality Emergence (social smile, temperament, early relational health)*
- HealthyChildren.org – Emotional & Social Development Birth to 3 Months  
  https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/Emotional-and-Social-Development-Birth-to-3-Months.aspx
- AAP – Parenting Your Infant (patient education)  
  https://publications.aap.org/patiented/article/doi/10.1542/peo_document347/81975/Parenting-Your-Infant
- AAP – Helping Parents Deal with Infant Temperamental Differences  
  https://www.aap.org/en-us/advocacy-and-policy/aap-health-initiatives/practicing-safety/Pages/Temperament-Tips.aspx
- HealthyChildren.org – When do babies first smile?  
  https://www.healthychildren.org/English/tips-tools/ask-the-pediatrician/Pages/When-do-babies-first-smile.aspx

*Maternal Fitness Recovery (post‑partum exercise guidelines at ~12 weeks)*
- ACOG – Physical Activity and Exercise During Pregnancy and the Postpartum Period (Committee Opinion, 2020)  
  https://www.acog.org/clinical/clinical-guidance/committee-opinion/articles/2020/04/physical-activity-and-exercise-during-pregnancy-and-the-postpartum-period
- ACOG – Exercise After Pregnancy FAQ
